english.title: Without lawful authority or excuse erect building / fence or plant a hedge in highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse,

(A)_[erected a building]_
(B)_[erected a fence]_
(C)_[planted a hedge]_

in a highway, which consisted of or comprised a carriageway, located at **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE HIGHWAY..)
